examples.text: Kit überlegt kurz, dann grinst sie. „Vielleicht bin ich auch einfach streitlustig und habe keine Angst vor Konfrontationen.“
examples.translation: Kit réfléchit un instant, puis sourit : "Peut-être que je suis simplement belliqueuse et que je n'ai pas peur de la confrontation".

glosses: bereit, sich zu streiten, Streitlust verspürend

examples.text: „Also fühlte ich mich nach meinem Besuch bei Monroe geil und streitlustig ...“

glosses: Consisting of scraps; fragmentary; lacking unity or consistency.
Having an aggressive spirit; inclined to fight or strive.

examples.text: He's a scrappy dog and will charge at you if you taunt him.
In those days PGS [Portsmouth Grammar School] was full of sadistic staff and scrappy boys called things like Smudger, Muzz and Titch.

The [Washington] Post's proprietor through those turbulent [Watergate] days, Katharine Graham, held a double place in Washington’s hierarchy: at once regal Georgetown hostess and scrappy newshound, ready to hold the establishment to account.

glosses: (Of a fight) characterised by lots of ungainly or wild punches, grabs, wrestling, etc.
(Of a sports match) characterised by awkward or clumsy play.
